name: Sprouts (Alfalfa)
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in SIBO as they are FODMAP-free and easily digestible. Start with smaller portions if very sensitive.
preparationTips: Rinse thoroughly before eating to remove any bacteria
Add to sandwiches and salads just before serving to maintain crispness
Store in refrigerator and use within 2-3 days of purchase
Pat dry with paper towels after rinsing to prevent soggy dishes
